description: mod-finance configuration template. Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-finance revision 14, image 5.2.1); see ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. mod-finance is a stateless RMB business-logic module over mod-finance-storage: it has no database, no Kafka and no secret store, so it reads only JVM options and logging configuration from the environment. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-finance container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-finance container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-finance container in MiB

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size. Value taken from bugfest; with MaxMetaspaceSize it leaves only about 128 MiB of the container for non-heap memory

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size. Value taken from bugfest

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Threshold for the first metaspace garbage collection, not a limit. Value taken from bugfest

deployment.description: mod-finance is stateless: all data lives in mod-finance-storage and the in-memory caches are per-replica, so replicas run side by side without coordination.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient for mod-finance endpoints.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the module process. -Dhttp.port=8082 moves RMB off its default port 8081, which the Eureka sidecar uses; it must match the sidecar's MODULE_URL. Heap sizing comes from the java block.

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: External Log4j2 configuration file overriding the bundled log4j2.properties; the bundled log4j2-json.properties can be selected for JSON logs

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the sidecar container in MiB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier; must match the other modules and sidecars

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the sidecar: sizing from the java block plus the Quarkus flags set on bugfest

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL at which the mod-finance container is reachable from its sidecar; the port must match the module's http.port

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-finance module deployed alongside this sidecar
